answer: To curb Sybil attacks, agents must lock collateral in a decentralized vault and execute cryptographic stake burning. Registering identity n enforces a superlinear cost scaling as O(n^2), so an attacker faces an exponential economic penalty. Replicating agents sparks a fiscal spiral that rapidly depletes reserves, making mass identity spoofing as futile as transcribing a complex sonnet by brute-force trial.
